note: The candidate AV1 tile bitstream controls the entropy reader result that admits a non-zero transform block.
Entropy-coded eob_pt and eob_extra from the same input determine how many scanned coefficients will be reconstructed.
The decoder advances the coefficient-buffer offset by the transform area without enforcing that the next block remains inside the fixed superblock coefficient buffer.
The unchecked offset selects the per-transform coefficient write base inside the heap-allocated coding-block buffer.
A decoded non-zero coefficient is written as a 4-byte tran_low_t through the offset-derived pointer, overflowing the coefficient buffer when the offset/scan position is outside its allocation.
